name: CIT 50% fee concession (including apprentices)
summary: Half-price CIT course fees for Health Care Card, Pensioner Concession Card and DVA card holders, including Australian Apprentices and their dependants.
key: Eligible students, including Australian Apprentices, may receive a 50% concession on course fees.
who: Hold a Pensioner Concession Card, Health Care Card or DVA pension card
Apprentices under 18 listed as a dependant on a parent's card
Apprentices without a card may qualify as low-income earners (payslips) or through financial hardship
how: Submit the CIT Concession Application Form with evidence before your first class.
catches: Not available for commercial courses, international fees, resource or project fees, excursions or printing.
Not available where a government agency or employer pays your fees.

evidence.quote: Eligible students, including Australian Apprentices, may receive a 50% concession on course fees
will also be eligible to receive a 50% fee reduction if you are listed as a dependent
can assist with course costs for eligible students who are experiencing financial hardship
